# Kiss Gel Fantasy Short Design Press-On Nails

## Vivid Color with Gel Shine

Make a bold statement with Kiss Gel Fantasy short press-on nails. Each nail features a vivid, two-coat color finish and a gel-coated surface that adds an amazing gel shine. Shoppers rate this set 4.4 stars out of 5.

## Find Your Fit at Home

This set includes 28 nails in 14 sizes, so you can match each nail to your nail bed for a natural look. Skip the salon appointment and create a polished manicure in your own space.

## Everything You Need in One Box

Each pack includes 24 adhesive tabs, pink gel glue (0.7 oz / 2 g), a mini file, and a manicure stick. Use the adhesive tabs for quick application, or use the gel glue for a custom hold. The mini file and manicure stick help you shape and place each nail with ease.

## Ready for Your Next Look

Ideal for weekend plans, a short getaway, or a quick color refresh, these nails make it easy to switch up your style. Add Kiss Gel Fantasy to your cart today and bring vivid color and gel shine to your next manicure.
